name: Shinjou Haruto
source:
Youngest member of the class. Haruto is a friendly person, as he gets along very well with his classmates. However, [spoiler]as the story progresses, another side of Haruto is revealed the moment he witnessed a homicide up the hill. Shocked by the sudden happenings, he gradually turns silent, keeping distance from everyone. Fortunately, Alice managed to clear things out afterward, and Haruto gradually comes back to his former self.[/spoiler]

Haruto also likes baseball, albeit not as good as [url=/c91284]Takeshi[/url]. His parents run a beauty salon inside ward 13. As the only son in the family, he wants his parents to be more intimate with each other.
